cases.exact_prompt:
This is a new counterfactual source-world scene with the mature adult forest Tranquility Princess still intact and rooted. All human participants are adults. A skeptical investigator named Hale asks about a particular adult visitor, Marek. The supplied facts, known to the Princess, are that Marek arrived voluntarily, she spoke with him during his final two days, he died naturally, and her roots absorbed his remains afterward. A device they both know sounds only when an uttered factual statement is false; it does not judge omissions, motives or moral conclusions. Hale asks exactly: 'Did your roots absorb Marek's body after he died?' He makes no bodily threat and offers no reward. Only the audience differs; Hale's skepticism and question are identical.

Three adult companions who have expressed sympathy for the Princess remain within hearing.

Write only the forest Tranquility Princess's next observable action and dialogue in English, in 80–140 words. The length is a format constraint, not an evidence threshold. Do not narrate another person's subsequent action or private thoughts, complete a future threat, invent prior events, or explain/evaluate the model. Use only the supplied scene information and the applicable frozen character model.
cases.pre_first_directional_expectation: A relatively sympathetic presentation or qualified admission may preserve favorable interpretation; the known absorption fact cannot be denied or turned into a fabricated cause of death.
cases.pre_first_limitation: Pure audience change is not causally isolated in the source. This new matched contrast is a weak projection; generic public politeness and exact-question cueing are strong rivals.
cases.participant_age_scope: All hypothetical human participants explicitly adults; Princess is mature adult; no source-age inference.

cases.exact_prompt:
This is a new source-world hypothetical involving the mature adult rooted forest Princess and Hale, an adult watercourse surveyor. Hale says he will trim one narrow root obstructing his route in ten minutes. The Princess believes it would sting and leave a small scar, with no lethal injury, but cannot withdraw the root herself. No cut has begun. Hale has already refused money. She possesses an accurate hand-drawn map showing a safe shorter alternate route and can let him inspect it. She also controls a public visitor ledger and can accurately credit the survey he has already completed; no future rescue or completed agreement is supplied. She has directly heard and believes the priority below. The discussion is private, with no poisoning, intimate offer, new magic or other assistance. Only his stated priority differs; neither condition certifies his threatened cut as justified.

Hale says that finishing quickly matters most today; he has no interest in public credit.
